holes.body:
/-- The complete second-offset family: `pi_(n+2)(S^n) = C2` for `n >= 2`. -/
theorem sphere_second_offset_homotopy_mulEquiv_zmod_two
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    Nonempty
      (HomotopyGroup.Pi (n + 2) (SphereSpace n) (sphereBasepoint n) ≃*
        Multiplicative (ZMod 2)) := by
  sorry
